one_line: Painter and teacher-critic reshaping Calcutta art education toward Indian and Asian visual lineages during the Bengal School era.

appearance.age_look: Abanindranath appears in his late 30s, slim but slightly stooped from desk work; Havell appears in his mid-40s, medium build with a scholar’s posture.
appearance.face: Abanindranath has an oval face, medium-brown complexion, fine moustache, soft but intent eyes with a thoughtful, slightly introverted default expression; Havell has a long, fair-complexioned face with a neatly trimmed moustache, high nose, and calm, observant default expression.
appearance.hair: Abanindranath’s hair is dark, wavy, combed back and medium-length, with a simple, narrow off-white cotton headband barely visible at the temples; Havell’s hair is light brown, short, neatly parted on the left, with no headwear.
appearance.costume: Abanindranath wears a long, cream-coloured khadi kurta with a straight band collar and slim cuffs, over a slightly darker beige dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a neat front pleat, paired with a light, handloom off-white shawl with a thin rust-red border folded over his left shoulder, and simple brown leather sandals; Havell wears a dark charcoal-grey wool three-piece suit with a high-buttoned jacket, subtly tapered trousers, and a matching waistcoat over a crisp white cotton shirt with a small pointed collar and a muted deep-blue tie, along with polished brown leather lace-up shoes.
appearance.signature: Abanindranath carries a rectangular wooden drawing board under his left arm with a clipped sheet showing faint wash strokes, and in his right hand a slim bamboo-handled brush with dark bristles; Havell carries a small, worn brown leather notebook in his left hand and a slender metal pen in his right, as if ready to annotate student work.

ref_desc: Abanindranath Tagore is a slim late-30s Bengali man in cream kurta, beige dhoti, off-white shawl, brown sandals, dark wavy hair and headband holding a wooden drawing board and bamboo brush beside E.B. Havell, a fair mid-40s Englishman in charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, deep-blue tie and brown shoes holding a brown notebook and metal pen, using a cream, off-white, beige, charcoal and deep-blue palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two men standing side by side in a Calcutta art-school courtyard, showing them front-on with clear views of face, hair, clothing and props: Abanindranath Tagore is a slim Bengali man appearing late-30s with an oval medium-brown face, fine moustache and thoughtful eyes, dark wavy medium-length hair combed back with a narrow off-white cotton headband, wearing a long cream khadi kurta with band collar and slim cuffs over an ankle-length beige dhoti wrapped with a neat front pleat, a light off-white handloom shawl with a thin rust-red border folded over his left shoulder, and simple brown leather sandals; he holds a rectangular wooden drawing board under his left arm with a clipped sheet showing faint wash strokes and a slim bamboo-handled brush with dark bristles in his right hand. Beside him stands E.B. Havell, a fair-complexioned Englishman appearing mid-40s with a long face, neatly trimmed moustache, calm observant eyes and light brown hair cut short and neatly parted on the left, wearing a dark charcoal-grey wool three-piece suit with a high-buttoned jacket, matching waistcoat, and subtly tapered trousers, over a crisp white cotton shirt with a small pointed collar and a muted deep-blue tie, along with polished brown leather lace-up shoes; he holds a small worn brown leather notebook in his left hand and a slender metal pen in his right as if ready to make notes. Keep the palette centered on cream, beige, off-white, charcoal grey and deep blue, with clean linework and consistent proportions so this pairing can be redrawn identically in multiple panels.
